text:
deploybot: RELEASE HOLD — slot 17234 paused due to incident INC-2026-093 (kvcache eviction spike). Pausing all non-critical rollouts in eu-west-1. Active canaries quarantined. Oncall: @ops.

alice: Which services are hit? I have a canary rollout for orbit-service v2.4.1 in that slot.

ben: Confirmed — orbit-service canary is in slot 17234. Recommend pinning the current version and moving the slot to a later window. Suggest non-critical rollouts move to 16:00 UTC.

ops-bot: Noted. Incident impact: elevated 5xx/503s caused by redis leader flaps. SRE investigating; ETA for next status ~20m.

carol: Agree on pin. We should also nail down rollback criteria before making a rollback decision.

dinesh: Proposal for rollback triggers: error-rate increase > 0.5% relative baseline over a 5m window OR p95 latency > 2s sustained for 10m. Additionally abort if backend 5xx ratio > 1%.

alice: LGTM. Also disable auto-canary-swap for that slot and cancel any scheduled rollouts referencing it.

ben: Commands to pin + disable auto-swap:
```
deployctl pin --service orbit-service --version v2.4.1 --slot 17234
deployctl config set --slot 17234 --auto-swap false\```

deploybot: Pin applied for orbit-service slot 17234 (actioned by ben at 4412345690). auto-swap set to false.

carol: Ops, please reschedule the slot to the next safe window and add a line in release notes that this hold is incident-induced.

ops-bot: Reschedule proposal: move slot 17234 to 2026-03-19 16:00 UTC (new slot 17289). If incident clears by 15:30 UTC we can consider an earlier reinstatement.

dinesh: Also add canary preflight: run generation workload (50k tokens synthetic + latency profile). If preflight regresses, do not proceed.

alice: I'll update the release PR and mark the changelog: "hold - incident INC-2026-093" and ping product.

ben: Should we add a short rollback playbook? I can draft: 1) pin older version, 2) drain new pods / freeze traffic, 3) route traffic back to previous slot, 4) invalidate caches and clear KV prefix.

carol: Please do. Also mute noisy deploybot alerts for pinned slots so oncall isn't spammed.

ops-bot: Note: deploybot will prevent automatic retries for a pinned slot. To unpin later:
```
deployctl unpin --slot 17234\```

alice: Thanks all — holding for ops update. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Update 14:36 UTC: redis leader stabilized; 503s falling back to baseline. Ops recommends holding until 15:00 UTC for observation, then re-evaluate.

ben: OK — we'll keep the slot pinned until 15:00 UTC. If stable, run the preflight and then proceed with the rollout.

dinesh: I'll start the preflight once ops gives green at 15:00.

(End of thread)
